report_title: Loss of Oversight: How AI systems may become harder to audit
finding: Drawing on 25 expert interviews plus a literature review, the report examines five sources of oversight signal (behaviour, chain-of-thought, activations/circuits, memory architectures, and honesty training) and offers three recommendations: track and report oversight-relevant changes, preserve oversight affordances by design, and invest in backup oversight techniques.

report_title: AI and the future of work: Measuring AI-driven productivity
finding: Across workplace tasks, AI assistance produced an overall ~61% improvement in the points-per-minute (efficiency) metric, with results varying by task: Technical Drafting saw a 23% quality improvement, 34% time reduction, and 86% points-per-minute increase, while Monitoring Processes showed a 22% quality uplift but no time or efficiency gains.
